svg.title: catalunya-2020 authentic F1 circuit outline
svg.desc: Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Formula1_Circuit_Catalunya.svg; creator: Will Pittenger; Sentoan (2017 revision); license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). PitPitch adaptation: isolate exact original route path, omit all labels, numbers, pit lanes, sector colours and background, recolour black and crop empty margin. Derivative distributed under CC-BY-SA-3.0. Original SHA-256: 8a0884bdfbccc70a37667ad6e1a08b0a4a1f5929391f791506fb063125d1cbbd.
Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
